<thought>We need to determine the number of methyl groups in the molecule. The available tools can provide NMR spectra for the sample at hand. By retrieving the 13C NMR spectrum, we can identify signals in the typical methyl carbon region (around 10–30 ppm). Counting those distinct signals will give the number of methyl carbons, which equals the number of methyl groups. We'll request the carbon NMR spectrum.</thought>
